title: Forward a message
summary: Sends a copy of sent messages to one or more chats of the same account (bipe-chat/bipe#664): text, photo, video, file, voice message and location. Media keeps its source on the server and is not downloaded or uploaded again. Selection mode forwards or deletes several messages at once (bipe-chat/bipe#860).

chats.description: The joined chats of the account (Client.rooms with membership joined, spaces left out), by name, the chat of the message included. Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#664): by name, because the timeline screen has no chat list order and the search finds a chat fast. mz can overrule.

query.description: Filters chats by name, ignoring case and accents.

picked.description: At most forwardChats (registries/voice-media.json, 5). When a content the forward sends has a count of forwardedManyTimes or more (the original count plus 1), at most forwardChatsManyTimes (1): forwardChatLimit, test-vectors/forward-marks.json chatLimit (bipe-chat/bipe#933). A pick over the limit is not added and shows bipe_forward_limit with the limit, or bipe_forward_limit_many when the limit is forwardChatsManyTimes.

isSending.description: true while the copies go out; the picker takes no input.

selection.description: Selection mode of chat-timeline (bipe-chat/bipe#860). Missing while the mode is off. At most 10. An 11th tap shows bipe_select_limit with the limit and is not added.

rowIds.description: One message from message-actions, or the selection.

open.effect: Opens the picker as a sheet over chat-timeline, titled bipe_forward_title.

toggle.effect: Adds or removes the chat from picked. A picked chat shows a check mark, not only a colour.

send.effect: The button bipe_forward_action, off while picked is empty. For each picked chat and each message, in timeline order: Room.sendRaw with event type m.room.message and the content from BipeForwardMark (test-vectors/forward-marks.json): the content of the original event JSON (EventTimelineItemDebugInfo.originalJson), or the m.new_content of its latest edit (latestEditJson), without m.relates_to, m.new_content and m.mentions (no reply, no thread, no mentions), with the chat.bipe.forward mark set to the count of the original plus 1 (registries/voice-media.json forwardKey). Room.sendRaw encrypts in an encrypted room. Media sources stay as they are. Then closes and shows bipe_forward_done for one message, bipe_select_forward_done for more, and ends selection mode. A chat whose send failed shows bipe_forward_failed with its name; the others stay sent.

rowId.description: The message of the long press.

startSelection.effect: message-actions select: turns selection mode on with this message picked. The composer gives its place to the selection bar: bipe_select_count with the number, bipe_forward_action, bipe_app_message_action_delete and bipe_app_cancel. Rows take no other input while the mode is on.

toggleSelection.effect: A tap on a selectable row adds or removes it. A picked row shows a check mark, not only a colour. Removing the last one ends the mode.

forwardSelection.effect: bipe_forward_action of the bar, on only when every picked message can be forwarded: open with the selection.

deleteSelection.effect: bipe_app_message_action_delete of the bar, on when at least one picked message is own with canDelete (message-delete). One dialog, bipe_select_delete_title and bipe_select_delete_body; confirm runs Timeline.redactEvent for each own picked message, without a reason, and ends the mode. A failure shows bipe_select_delete_failed.

cancelSelection.effect: bipe_app_cancel of the bar, Android back or leaving the chat: ends the mode, nothing is sent.

notes: Which messages: a sent message (it has an event ID) of kind message (MsgLikeKind.message). Stickers, polls, undecryptable and deleted messages have no forward. Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#664): polls are not forwarded, because a copied poll would collect votes in another chat. mz can overrule.

Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#664): at most 5 chats per forward (forwardChats), because more is a broadcast. Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#933): a message forwarded many times goes to 1 chat at a time (forwardChatsManyTimes), the brake other messengers put on chain messages. mz can overrule.

The copy carries the chat.bipe.forward mark (bipe-chat/bipe#83). Every forwarded message type gets the mark. Every row shows it: voice messages and audio files in their source line (voice-message), all other kinds in the forward line of chat-timeline (bipe-chat/bipe#933).

Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#83): a message whose event JSON the app does not have (a local echo before the server copy arrives) has no forward, because a copy without the mark would show as recorded in the app. MZ can overrule.

Selection mode (bipe-chat/bipe#860): selectable rows are sent messages that can be forwarded or own messages with canDelete. Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#860): at most 10 messages, the number in the issue. mz can overrule.
Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#860): bipe_forward_action stays off while a picked message cannot be forwarded (an own sticker), because a forward that skips messages is a surprise. mz can overrule.

Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#860): when one message of the selection fails for a chat, the rest is not sent there and the chat shows in bipe_forward_failed, so the copies never arrive out of order. mz can overrule.
Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#860): Apagar deletes only own messages, also for a group admin, because the issue asks for own messages. mz can overrule.
